description: Read a Take Friday Off page in full, as Markdown with absolute links: a service, pathway, format or guide page (with its questions, case studies and sources), a case study (/work/<slug>), a note (/notes/<slug>), or a core page (/, /system, /work, /about, /partner, /contact). Give a URL, a path or a slug, and optionally one section by its heading words. With no page, returns the list of pages.

section.description: Optional: one section by its heading words or anchor, e.g. "fees" or "sunscreens"

name: tfo_get_page
title: Read a page
